title: Run batch 3 on Laya, then Jev on explicit go
description: One GPU job at a time; Jev only after spend is priced and approved.

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: Batch 3 runs Laya first, Jev only on explicit go

Scenario: Jev is never called without a priced, approved go
  Given batch 3's pre-registration is committed and only one GPU job may run at a time
  When I run bd run for batch 3 against Laya, and separately attempt a Jev run without an explicit approved go
  Then the Laya run completes and records answers, and the Jev run is refused until a price and cap have been approved

right_now_summary: Batch 3 runs on Laya first; Jev waits for explicit approval of its price and cap.
